title: Qiu et al. 2025 — Global CNN Oxide Maps (Clementine UVVIS + Chang'E-6)
description: Global chemical composition maps of the lunar surface derived from Clementine UVVIS 5-band reflectance data using a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN). Covers FeO, TiO2, Al2O3, MgO, and CaO abundances (wt%) and the Mg# derived index. Calibrated against 49 lunar sample ground-truth points including Chang'E-6 (first farside samples). 100 m/pixel, global coverage including poles. Published in Communications Earth & Environment (2025).
